# odinex_network (Resource)

Manages a private network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_network" "private" {
  name     = "private"
  ip_range = "10.0.0.0/16"
  location = "fra1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_range` (String) Private IPv4 range in CIDR notation, /16 to /28 (e.g. `10.0.0.0/16`). Changing it recreates the network.
- `location` (String) Location of the network, e.g. `fra1`. Changing it recreates the network.
- `name` (String) Name of the network.

### Optional

- `delete_protection` (Boolean) Prevent the resource from being deleted. Defaults to `false`.
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Up to 64 pairs; keys and values up to 63 characters.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `gateway` (String) Address kept for a NAT gateway: the first host of `ip_range`.
- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.
- `nat_gateway_id` (Number) ID of the network's NAT gateway (see `odinex_nat_gateway`), if any.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import odinex_network.private 3
```
